plugins.name: Tracefold Discovery
plugins.description: Authenticated website and API discovery with multi-user authorization testing. Crawls as a saved user, maps API calls to the pages that make them, and compares endpoint access across accounts.

versions.notes: Runs inside the Tracefold window, follows the Tracefold theme, and stores accounts, sessions, scans and reports in its own persistent plugin directory. The first launch prepares a private Python environment and Chromium build.
